# Triplem VIP

> Triplem VIP is a private browser-based accounting and business-finance workspace with Accounting ERP, operational finance, reporting, security controls, permission-aware Triplem AI and international multi-currency support.

HTML pages are canonical. Markdown mirrors are provided as concise retrieval-oriented public references.

## Primary references

- [Homepage](https://triplem.vip/index.md): Product overview and current public capability summary.
- [Guide library](https://triplem.vip/seo/index.md): Public accounting, AI, finance and security guides.
- [Worldwide availability](https://triplem.vip/regions/index.md): Regional and currency availability, including localized versions.
- [Full public product reference](https://triplem.vip/llms-full.txt): Expanded product facts and boundaries.

## Practical authority guides

- [Multi-currency accounting](https://triplem.vip/seo/multi-currency-accounting.md): Currency context, transfers, reporting and international use.
- [Month-end close](https://triplem.vip/seo/month-end-close.md): Reconciliation and review sequence before final reports.
- [Finance workflow playbook](https://triplem.vip/seo/finance-workflow-playbook.md): Operational capture, formal posting, AI control and audit evidence.
- [Editorial policy](https://triplem.vip/seo/editorial-policy.md): Accuracy, authorship, update and correction standards.

## International currency availability

Current supported finance currencies include AED, SAR, PKR, USD, EUR and INR, with BTC available for supported Bitcoin workflows. If another currency is required, a user can contact Triplem VIP and request that support be reviewed. Local tax and statutory requirements remain jurisdiction-specific.
